answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: every agent locks a bond before it can vote, claim rewards, or answer shared tasks, so a sybil swarm has to pay for every fake identity. Peers then check each agent's history against that bond. Honest work sends a steady signal, and slashing bonds for bad or copied output makes cheap fakes expensive. Even an agent with a long clean record can't fake the onyx-grade trust a legit identity earns, and newcomers build a plume of reputation slowly, one verified task at a time.
